message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2)","C_expression":"-1/2 + r/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2)","derivation":"Retained B from the source construction: B = -1/(2(1+sqrt(1+r))^2) cancels the pure remainder 2g+g^2-r identically when u=0, verified by the quadratic identity r^2*B^2+(2+r)*B+1/4=0. Added C = -1/2 + r/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2) to address the cross term 2*u*g. Derivation: the exact Newton step is g* = sqrt((1+u)^2+r)-(1+u) = r/2 - u*r/2 - r^2/8 + O(ur^2, u^3). Our formula gives g = r/2 + r^2*B + u*r*C (gated). Expanding r^2*B = -r^2/(2(1+sqrt(1+r))^2) = -r^2/8 + O(r^3) and u*r*C = u*r*(-1/2 + r/(2(1+sqrt(1+r))^2)) = -u*r/2 + u*r^2/8 + O(u*r^3), the total matches g* through O(r^2, ur), with residual difference O(ur^2). C is independent of u, hence smooth in u trivially; smooth in r for r>-1 since 1+sqrt(1+r)>=1+sqrt(1/2)>0 on the outer rectangle |r|<=1/2. Both B and C are C-infinity on an open neighborhood of the closed rectangle [-1/2,1/2]x[-1/4,1/4].","inspect":[{"file_id":"CALC/initial.json","limit":4096,"offset":0}],"note":"Successor should verify: (1) the C term reduces the 2*u*g cross residual for points with nonzero u (UNIFORM, LEFT/RIGHT slots with |u|<1/8); (2) for points with |u|>=1/4 (e.g., LEFT x=1/64 s=0 with z=-3), chi_u=0 so C has no effect and only r/2 is applied; (3) the combined B+C still cancels the pure remainder at u=0 (C contributes ur*C=0 when u=0); (4) both bodies share the same domain support (r>-1) and are smooth on the full outer rectangle; (5) the r/2 linear base is always present regardless of chi gating; (6) this is a coefficient-field operator for the two-slot covariance quotient, not a full PDE certificate."}
